correctness.rationale: Anchor-column elimination gives a two-by-two signed-difference determinant. The phase-ratio reality argument forces matching row-pair sums; irreducibility of the pth cyclotomic polynomial plus zero total coefficient sum forces an integral group-ring equality. Its fourth-residue moment yields (r²-s²)(t1²-t2²)=0. Both equality branches are sufficient, and any singular case has rank three, not lower. Exact disjoint pair-sum counting establishes the incidence. A standard-library checker confirmed all configurations for p=3,5,7,11.

value.rationale: The result completely classifies identifiability for an intrinsic minimal two-channel paired-anchor design on every even semiprime cyclic grid, with a sharp midpoint obstruction and exact failure probability decaying as 3/p². It is neither the trivial all-spark prime theorem nor a finite enumeration; it gives an infinite arithmetic rank boundary and incident count for a naturally defined interpolation scheme. It does not claim the full Fourier minor census.
